India to Host Inaugural Women's Champions Trophy in 2027

India will host the inaugural ICC Women's Champions Trophy in 2027. The International Cricket Council (ICC) shifted the event from Sri Lanka to India. Mumbai is confirmed as one of the two venues for the tournament. The specific dates for the tournament have also been confirmed.
